entities.summary: Antônio Gaspar is a Brazilian Roman Catholic prelate, who served as bishop of the Diocese of Barretos from 2000 to 2008. He previously served as auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of São Paulo and titular bishop of Cozyla from 1982 to 2000.
